label: scam
title: [Hinglish] Fake customs/CBI officer, pay to avoid arrest
sources: FTC/IC3 government-impersonation pattern, code-mixed Hindi-English variant

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Main CBI officer bol raha hoon. Aapke naam se ek parcel pakda gaya hai jisme illegal saman hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Par maine toh koi parcel nahi bheja.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Case darj ho chuka hai. Aapko abhi 75,000 rupaye jama karne honge, gift card ya crypto se, warna arrest.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yeh baat kisi ko mat batana aur phone mat katna, nahi toh case aur badh jayega.
